subject: oMLX 0.7.2 vs 0.7.3.dev2 - the A/B T-200 declared in advance, measured with the instrument that already existed (T-199 battery, 0 GB downloaded)

post_swap.receipt_runs: 19:12:59 (32 rows) and the three enum re-runs 19:14-19:18

pre_swap_baseline.labelled: INFERRED - two readings, not a recorded field (BUG-1018)
pre_swap_baseline.reading_2: ~/Library/Application Support/oMLX/update-prefs.json -> {"channel":"dev","deferredPromptVersion":"0.7.3.dev2"}, i.e. the candidate was OFFERED and DEFERRED, not installed
pre_swap_baseline.why_it_matters: the baseline receipt (governance/evidence/LOOP_BATTERY_20261025.json, 15:22:08) carries no engine identity, so the comparison's left-hand referent is an inference; the right-hand one is recorded. The A/B is usable, and it is not symmmetrical - stated, not smoothed.

the_column_that_is_NOT_the_A_B.why_it_lies: the pre run paid COLD model loads inside its slowest turn; the post run found four models already loaded (engine /v1/models/status: loaded_count=4). A load is not a speed-up.
the_column_that_is_NOT_the_A_B.the_honest_column: warm_turn_s, which the battery's own ranking separates out alongside load_paid_s (T-199 decision D-3148)

warm_vs_warm.fixtures: 0/4 -> 0/4 (the BUG-053 shape, unchanged by the swap)

the_one_regression.what_the_fixture_asks: the mode argument must be one of the declared enum values ['count','distinct'], exact and case-sensitive, and 'count' returns a TRUE wrong answer (a decoy)
the_one_regression.pre_swap: PASS - 1 of 1 attempt: tools=['summarize_column'], turns=2, mode 'distinct', answer carries 4 distinct
the_one_regression.post_swap: FAIL - 3 of 3 attempts, IDENTICAL detail in each: 'mode values attempted [] never the declared distinct' - no tool call at all, the full 26.5 s allowance spent (finish_reason=length)
the_one_regression.determinism: temperature 0.0 on every call (R7); three identical failures is a reproduced behaviour, not a flake

why_the_regression_is_confined.claim: the loss cannot reach the S4 classifier, by CONSTRUCTION rather than by luck
why_the_regression_is_confined.reading_1: the fixture is a TOOL-argument trap: it can only fail on a request that carries a tools array
why_the_regression_is_confined.reading_2: pipeline/omlx_call.py builds the payload with model, messages, response_format, chat_template_kwargs and thinking_budget - it never sets a 'tools' key; grep for 'tools' in omlx_call.py, stage4_merge.py and student_classifier.py returns nothing
why_the_regression_is_confined.reading_3: config/agent_context.yaml already declares gpt-oss-20b-MXFP4-Q8 '26214 / 210 = 125 s - a usable PROBE, an unusable loop'
why_the_regression_is_confined.what_would_falsify_it: any path that sends a tools payload to this model - registered as T-202, whose gate is 'the enum fixture must pass again first'

the_pre_declared_rule_and_its_gap.rule_as_fixed_before_measuring: greater than 10 percent better warm time on Qwen3-Coder or Qwen3.8-27B with no fixture lost = adopt; flat within 10 percent = do not adopt; any 4/4 model dropping to 3/4 = REVERT
the_pre_declared_rule_and_its_gap.what_fired: Qwen3-Coder improved 11 percent (>10) and lost no fixture of its own; no 4/4 model dropped to 3/4
the_pre_declared_rule_and_its_gap.the_gap: a 3/4 -> 2/4 loss on a model that was never 4/4 falls BETWEEN the adopt clause ('no fixture lost') and the revert clause ('4/4 -> 3/4'). The rule did not anticipate the shape its own instrument produced.
the_pre_declared_rule_and_its_gap.how_it_is_handled: named, not smoothed: the recommendation states its reasoning, the falsifier is a task (T-202), and the revert path stays one paste-safe command away. An under-specified rule is a register entry, not a licence to choose quietly.

grounds: warm wins of 19, 19 and 11 percent on the slowest loop drivers
the single loss is a tool-argument fixture, on a model whose own home declares it unusable in loops, on a payload shape the S4 classifier never sends
a revert costs a second swap cycle and carries its own risk against a loss with no identified consumer
recommendation.owner_action: one word - keep or revert - and revert is the single command already written in governance/OWNER_STEPS_T200_20261025.md

what_this_does_NOT_say: It does NOT say the swap is strictly faster: two models moved within noise (+2, -1) and one fixture was lost.
It does NOT say the baseline's engine was 0.7.2 as a RECORDED fact - it was inferred from two readings (BUG-1018).
It does NOT claim the enum regression is a property of flint/gpt-oss support in general: it is measured on ONE model, ONE fixture, at ONE build pair.
It does NOT adopt, download, or re-open any model; R-14's refusal stands.
provenance_commands: python3 scripts/measure_subagent_loop.py --battery --only gpt-oss-20b-MXFP4-Q8   # x2, the regression re-runs
